info.title: Payment Gateway API v1
info.description: Public contract of the capstone sitting (I-11 slice only). Source of truth: Lab 1 index (I-1 contract 'REST API — OpenAPI 3.0 specification for /v1/payments endpoints'), Lab 3 §4 contract register, Lab 10 sequences. The runtime is the collapsed in-process build in this repo (see name-map.md); status codes and bodies below match it exactly — asserted by tests/test_openapi_contract.py. No real host is called: AcquirerHost and Merchant Platform are in-process mocks (I-3 mocked). Void Payment and Payment Query are N/A (not I-11 use cases) and intentionally absent.

contact.name: Team 3 — Dev R: Kim Duc Minh / SA A: Nguyen Quang Huy / Test C: Tran Quoc Dat

tags.name: payments
tags.description: I-11 use cases: Authorize Payment, Capture Payment, Refund Payment

post.description: Happy path: idempotency check -> Fraud Gate pass -> AcquirerHost approve -> persist Authorized -> publish payment.authorized (webhook delivered async). Named alt (I-11): Fraud blocks -> Declined, no acquirer call (CON.3, G5). capture:true runs the Direct Charge variant (I-6: Pending -> Captured). A duplicate idempotency key replays the original status and body (CON.2).

201.description: Authorized (I-6: Pending -> Authorized). A duplicate key replays this original 201 response.

200.description: Declined — named alt 'Fraud blocks' (CON.3, decline_reason 'fraud_rule') or issuer decline; or Captured — Direct Charge variant (capture:true). Duplicate keys replay whichever original response was cached.

400.description: invalid_request (CON.2 missing/oversized idempotency key or missing field), invalid_amount (CON.1 range 10,000–500,000,000 VND), invalid_card (Luhn/expiry).

409.description: Concurrent request with the same idempotency key still in flight (CON.2; the 5s wait is collapsed — see name-map.md).

post.description: Happy path: idempotency check -> validate (Authorized + not expired, amount <= authorized) -> AcquirerHost capture -> persist Captured -> publish payment.captured. Named alt (I-11): Auth expired -> 409 authorization_expired (CON.4, G5). amount < authorized runs the Partial Capture variant (remainder voided, Lab 10 §2). Fraud Gate is never on this path (CON.3).

200.description: Captured (I-6: Authorized -> Captured). remainder_voided is true on the Partial Capture variant.

400.description: invalid_request (missing field / CON.2 key) or amount_exceeds_authorized (Lab 10 §2 alt).

409.description: authorization_expired (named alt, CON.4 — no acquirer call, state unchanged), invalid_state_transition (status is not Authorized), idempotency_conflict (CON.2).

post.description: Happy path: idempotency check -> validate (Captured + amount <= refundable + refundCount < 10 + within 180d) -> AcquirerHost refund -> persist (partial stays Captured, full becomes Refunded) -> publish payment.refunded. Named alt (I-11): Max refunds exceeded -> 400 max_refunds_exceeded (CON.5, G5). Fraud Gate is never on this path (CON.3).

200.description: Partial refund keeps status Captured (I-6: Captured -> Captured, refundedAmount updated); full refund reaches terminal Refunded (I-6: Captured -> Refunded).

400.description: invalid_request (missing field / CON.2 key), max_refunds_exceeded (named alt, CON.5 — no acquirer call, counts unchanged), amount_exceeds_refundable (Lab 10 §3 alt).

409.description: refund_window_expired (CON.5 180-day window), invalid_state_transition (status is not Captured), idempotency_conflict (CON.2).

post.summary: Webhook delivery contract (Lab 3 §4 register: Webhook Service -> Merchant Platform)
post.description: Implemented by Merchant Platform (I-3, mocked by MerchantPlatformFake), called by Webhook Service after the Message Queue is drained — never inside the synchronous API response (I-5). Retry per CON.7: 7 attempts on the 1m/5m/30m/2h/12h/24h schedule (delays are labels in the collapsed build), then the event is recorded failed_delivery. This operation is the merchant-facing delivery contract, not a route on Payment Gateway.

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the raw body, keyed with the simulated webhook secret (mock list, README).

200.description: Delivery accepted. Exhausted retries are recorded as failed_delivery Webhook Event rows by Webhook Service (CON.7) — no extra status is invented here.

number.description: PAN; Luhn-checked. Only the last 4 digits are persisted (card_ref).

bin_country.description: Default 'VN'; BIN country != VN blocks (FRAUD-04, CON.8).

idempotency_key.description: CON.2: required on all POST, 48h TTL (TTL is a label in the collapsed build).

capture.description: true = Direct Charge variant (I-6: Pending -> Captured).

merchant_id.description: Simulated merchant reference; defaults to 'mer_3' (ASSUMPTION row in name-map.md).

amount.description: Capture amount; must not exceed the authorized amount.
Refund amount; must not exceed capturedAmount - refundedAmount.

error.description: Machine-readable code; the exact set per operation+status is listed in the response's x-error-codes extension.
